summary: Assessment teaser integration passed local gates, PR preview checks, and staging smoke tests before production merge.
Dedicated staging Pages project was created to avoid suspicious project-hostname review URLs and isolate staging runtime configuration from production.
Actual staging hostname served the staging site through Cloudflare edge and accepted a website assessment teaser submission with 202 queued.
Microsoft site verification meta tag shipped with a matching SEO/AEO assertion added in the same commit.
C&J Welding client work deployed from main and verified across five production URLs including both hostnames and the machine-readable surfaces.
Project's first validation-strategy.json written after four generations without one, ahead of any Phase 2 implementation.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN verifies as active but has zero zone and account visibility, so it cannot create the intake DNS record. Automated remediation of a six-week-old High finding is blocked on credential scope.
